properties.description: Visible search pill inline in the bar — placeholder text + ⌘K kbd hint. Opens spotlight modal with grouped keyboard-navigable results. Tailwind/Linear/Raycast style.
properties.use_case: Search-heavy or docs-heavy products where search is a primary action
properties.anti_pattern: Faking modal with <div> that traps no focus and ignores Esc; generic button instead of search-looking pill
